events.body:
## Outcome

Every import ends with an exportable report showing exactly what arrived, what remains external, what failed, and what was verified.

## Scope

- Report counts and source identifiers by object type, refs and artifacts, checksums, retries, failures, and unresolved external dependencies.
- Sign the report and link each verification result to reproducible evidence without leaking secrets.
- Offer remediation, retry, and machine-readable export alongside a plain-language summary.

## Acceptance criteria

- Fixture totals reconcile source, imported, skipped, failed, and external records with no unclassified remainder.
- Tampering with report data or verified content is detected by an independent verifier.
- A maintainer can retry only failed work and receive a superseding report with preserved history.
- Linked automated evidence covers supported platforms, failure paths, rollback/recovery, documentation, and telemetry before closure.

## Delivery and dependencies

- Portfolio tier: **P0 release gate**
- Milestone: **Preservation public alpha**
- Numeric priority: **11 of 44** (1 is highest)
- Depends on: #477
- Assignee: unassigned until an accountable owner accepts the epic; fund independently releasable child issues rather than this umbrella epic.

## Progress baseline

**10% as of 2026-07-22.** Import status exists at the Git level, but complete object-level reconciliation, signed reports, remediation, and independent verification remain. Progress may not exceed 85% without end-to-end validation or 95% without security, documentation, telemetry, and rollout evidence.

## Verification and measures

Primary measures: Verified fidelity, unclassified records, retry recovery, report downloads, and support contacts per migration. Closure requires linked test runs, operational evidence, and current user-facing documentation.
events.title: Produce transparent cryptographic migration reports
